name: Build NDS
on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: devkitpro/devkitarm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Make icon
        run: base64 -d icon.b64 > icon.bmp
      - name: Install libnds and ndstool
        run: dkp-pacman -Sy --noconfirm nds-dev
      - name: Build
        run: make
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: elewiz-nds
          path: elewiz.nds
